title: feat(flow designer): add variables, say why Runs is empty, Debug takes the side column, and autosave reads 已保存 in the header
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgae1jRRi8FRrTxaZL

Fixes #34818 (slice 3 of 3: items 5 to 9, plus the approval help text moved from slice 2; slices 1 and 2 landed as #34850 and #34932). Surface per the seat's amendment 6954475081.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **变量页可以新增变量了。** 空状态说明变量是做什么的；「添加变量」新建一个不重名的文本变量，每行可改名称、类型、默认值、输入、输出。`$` 开头、空名、重名会被拦下并提示；还被步骤引用的变量不能改名或删除，提示里列出是哪些步骤（这张卡不自动改引用）。只读包仍是原来的列表。
- **运行页签分两种说法。** 从未发布的流程写「发布并启用后，这里显示每次运行的记录。」，并且不去请求运行记录；已发布但引擎不响应时只说引擎不可用。
- **调试面板占用右栏。** Studio 里流程的「属性」本来在右侧面板，进入「调试」后模拟器直接画在右侧面板里，画布独占中间；离开调试，属性面板带着原来的选中回来。没有右侧面板的布局下，属性栏不画，模拟器列加宽到属性栏的宽度。1280 宽实测「运行 / 单步 / 重置」和状态徽标完整可见。
- **自动保存不再弹提示。** 标题栏的「正在保存」落定为「已保存」，读屏读作「流程「X」已保存」，下次编辑前一直在；保存失败照旧显示错误条，另弹一条错误提示。其他 Studio 编辑器的保存提示不变。按席位裁定，徽标在流程自己的标题行里、紧挨流程名。
- **节点面板在 zh-CN 下没有英文了。** 包括条件分支的「分支方式」、审批的「解析为」「没有解析出审批人时」和分组占位，也包括实测才发现的、由服务端下发的审批人各列说明、「排除提交人」「备用审批人」和 SLA 升级各项说明。`quorum`、`per_group` 改为「法定人数」「分组会签」。审批人说明改为「插入时自带通过和驳回两条连线」。
- 元数据结构、引擎行为、发布检查都不变。

## What changes

**Item 5, the node panel in zh-CN (and the approval help text).**
- `inspectors/flow-node-config.ts`:
  - The approval `approvers` help says the node comes with an "approve" and a "reject" connection, instead of asking the author to label them (slice 2 inserts them).
  - `localizeField` and `localizeColumn` overlay a prose `placeholder`, and `localizeColumn` overlays a column `help`. Example literals (CEL, numbers, field names) stay as written.
- `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (`FLOW_FIELD_ZH`):
  - decision: `mode` and its two options; the branch columns' help and prose placeholders.
  - approval: `resolveAs`; `onEmptyApprovers` with all four options (including `fallback`); `excludeSubmitter`; `fallbackApprovers`; the escalation helps; `minApprovals` reads 法定人数 / 分组会签.
  - `APPROVER_COLS_ZH` is shared by `approvers` and `fallbackApprovers` (both are `ApprovalNodeApproverSchema`). It covers every column's label and help, including `organization`, plus a `platform_admin` option label.
- The served help: live, the panel draws the fields the engine publishes, whose help is the spec's `.describe()`. Seven of those strings were English in zh-CN. They are now in the table, and the test reads the fields from the spec's own JSON Schema, as the engine publishes them.

**Item 6, Debug takes the right column's place.**
- `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (flow pillar): while the section is `debug`, the Configuration aside is not drawn. The selection is kept.
  - In the surface's right slot, the chrome gets `debugTarget: slot.propsTarget`, and opening Debug calls `showProps()`, so the slot shows the half the simulator is drawn in.
  - In the classic row (no slot), nothing else is needed.
- `previews/FlowPreview.tsx`: `FlowPreviewChrome.debugTarget`. With a target, the simulator is portaled into it and the section keeps the canvas alone (`grid-cols-1`). Without one, the simulator column beside the canvas widens from 240px to the aside's 300px.
- `FlowSimulatorPanel.tsx`: the toolbar wraps (`flex-wrap`), the row the claim allows. Live readings at the slot's 419px:
  - idle: 运行 / 单步 / 重置 and the status fit on one row;
  - paused with 继续: 运行 / 单步 / 继续 / 重置 and 已暂停 fit on one row;
  - paused on an approval with `approve` and `reject` connections (slice 2's default): the status pill was clipped past the slot's edge before the wrap, and with the wrap it moves to a second row.

**Item 7, Add variable.**
- New `previews/FlowVariablesPanel.tsx` replaces the read-only `FlowVariablesList`, in both the chrome `variables` section and the classic side panel. It edits only with `onPatch` (the designer's `canEdit`).
  - Every write is the whole `variables` array, in the shape `FlowVariableSchema` parses. `objectName` rides along untouched.
  - Name refusals: blank, `$`-led (the spec's `flowBoundVariableNameSchema('variableName')`), or held by another variable.
  - Default values parse by type (number, `true`/`false`, a JSON object or list). A default the type cannot hold is held with a note, and so is a type change the current default cannot follow.
  - Rename and remove are refused while a step reads the variable. `flowVariableReaders` reads a whole-word mention in any string of a step (template holes and bare CEL alike), connection conditions, and the flow's `successMessage` / `errorMessage`. The read is deliberately wide, so a refusal can be stricter than the engine, never looser.
  - An input that declares `objectName` cannot be unticked (the spec refuses `objectName` on a non-input).

**Item 8, autosave says 已保存 in the header.**
- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (flow pillar): a landed draft save no longer calls `announceDraftSaved`. It sets `flowSavedFor`, and the header actions show `auto-autosaved`: a ✓ and 已保存, with an sr-only sentence naming the flow, in a `role="status"`. The next edit clears it.
  - It is shown only when nothing was edited in flight (`sent.unmoved()`).
  - A failed save raises one `toast.error` naming the flow, under one id per flow, beside the existing refusal strip.
- `StudioPillarKit.tsx`: comment only. `announceDraftSaved` no longer lists the flow pillar; its other callers are unchanged.
- Seat ruling 6954475081 holds this to ruling 6545938831 ② on #28345 (write feedback names the item): the badge sits in the flow header's own title row, beside the title, and its accessible text names the flow. Both are pinned.

**Item 9, Runs says why it is empty.**
- `previews/FlowRunsPanel.tsx`: a `published` prop. For `false` it says 发布并启用后… and does not fetch. For `true`, a failed fetch names the engine alone. For an unknown value, the old sentence stays.
- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: `readPublishedFlowNames` lists the served flows per scope (the package and its pair) beside the flow list, and the chrome passes `published` for the open flow. A failed read leaves it unknown.
  - **Deviation from the claim's wording.** The claim said `published` comes from "what the pillar already reads". It is a new read: one `listResponse('flow', { packageId })` per scope per rail load, with no per-row fan-out. The seat acked it as an extension of amendment 6954475081.

**Shared.** New and reworded keys in the lazy `studio` namespace (en and zh). No eager pack changes. Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Tests

- `inspectors/flow-node-config.zhPanel-34818.test.ts` (7 tests). This is the surface's `inspectorStrings.i18n-34818` row, written against the field tables directly.
  - Every decision and approval label, help, option, column and prose placeholder has CJK in zh-CN, both from the offline table and from the served fields (`jsonSchemaToFlowFields(z.toJSONSchema(ApprovalNodeConfigSchema / DecisionConfigSchema))`).
  - No `quorum` / `per_group`.
  - The approvers help is checked in zh and en.
  - en-US control: the overlay is the identity.
- `previews/FlowVariablesPanel-34818.test.tsx` (10 tests): add (two unique names), the edit of all five properties into one row, a held default, the three name refusals (the spec agrees on `$`), the reference guard on rename and remove with a control that renames and removes, the `objectName` input, the read-only control, the zh rows, and the reader's whole-word rule. Every write is parsed with `FlowVariableSchema`.
- `previews/FlowRunsPanel.render.test.tsx`: a new describe (4 tests): unpublished with no fetch, published engine-only, and the unknown and empty controls.
- `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.flowAutosave-34818.test.tsx` (9 tests), on the real `AutomationsPillar` with the real `FlowPreview` / `FlowInspector`:
  - item 8: the badge is in the header's title row beside the `h1`, its sr-only text names the flow, and no success toast; a second edit clears the badge; a refused save gives one error toast, the strip and no badge; the leaf control (an Interfaces page autosave still toasts by its label);
  - item 6: classic Debug hides the aside and widens to 300px, and Canvas brings it back with the selection; in the right slot, Debug draws the simulator in the slot, calls `showProps`, and keeps the section canvas-only; control: Canvas keeps the aside;
  - item 9: an unserved flow reads the unpublished sentence with no run fetch, and a served flow with a silent engine reads the engine sentence.
- Updated:
  - `previews/emptyCollection-8526.test.tsx`: the reworded `noVars` sentence.
  - `previews/flowFieldChrome.i18n-10862-s4.test.tsx`: an editable flow's variables panel shows Input / Output boxes and name values instead of in / out tags, so the case pins those keys.
  - Both, plus the new Studio test, take a module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` (`check:test-source-alias`).

Ablations (each restored, tree clean after):

| Mutation | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `flowsEmpty \|\| section === 'debug'` back to `flowsEmpty` | classic Debug test red |
| chrome `debugTarget: null` | right-slot Debug test red |
| drop `setFlowSavedFor(current.name)` | badge title-row and second-edit tests red |
| chrome `published: undefined` | both Studio Runs tests red |
| `flowVariableReaders` returns `[]` | reference-guard and reader tests red |
| `localizeColumn` without the help overlay | both served-fields zh tests red |

## Acceptance notes

- "zh-CN 下节点面板没有英文标签或英文说明": live. Start, decision, approval and end panels were read in zh-CN, and no line with an English phrase was left (the approval had 7 before the served-help fix).
- "1280 宽下调试工具栏四个按钮和状态都完整可见": live at 1280 in the right slot (419px).
  - Paused after 单步 ×3 on the approval: 运行 / 单步 / 继续 / 重置 and 已暂停 are on one row, in zh and en.
  - With `approve` / `reject` connections, the two decision buttons take 继续's place, and the toolbar wraps the status to a second row instead of clipping it.
  - The decision buttons show the connection keywords (Approve / Reject) in zh as well; they are left as they were, and named as a follow-up.
- "连续改三处配置，标题栏不被提示盖住": live. A variable was added, renamed and given a type and default. 0 toasts were on screen, and the header read ✓ 已保存 beside the switch.
- Item 9: an unpublished draft flow reads 发布并启用后…; a published showcase flow with the engine up reads 暂无运行记录 (control).

## Verification

Measured on head `56a158240`; `84f3858ad` adds only the toolbar's `flex-wrap`, after which the two `FlowSimulatorPanel` suites (6 tests) pass (base `c6ecd1fab`, main merged in at `f825d67a9`), on a shared box.

- Tests: the 218 test files under `metadata-admin` and `studio-design` that touch flows, the edited i18n tables, autosave or toasts on the final head: 218 files, 2977 passed and 1 skipped, exit 0. `packages/i18n`: 102 files, 1894 passed, 13 skipped, exit 0.
- Type-check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both projects) exit 0 on the final head. A first run failed on `columnMenuLabel` in code main brought (#34926), because the local `@object-ui/components` dist predated it. After `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components build` it exits 0. No file of this PR is involved.
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` on the merged tree gave 38. All 38 were run, plus `check:i18n` and `check:i18n-stale-fill`. 37 exited 0 at once. `check:test-source-alias` asked for the module-top lint import in three edited tests; after that it exits 0.
- Eager bundle: not measured. Every new key is in the lazy `studio` namespace, and no eager pack changed.
- Live: showcase backend (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase dev -- --fresh`), the console under Vite with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`, and Playwright at 1280×860 in zh-CN and en. The flow is a draft 「新会议提醒」 in an authored package, never published. The readings are in the comment below. The screenshots and the script are in the seat's project files under `objectstack-seat3/34818-live/slice3/`.
- Not run locally, left to CI: the full ui suite, `test:repo` and the dogfood battery (no `!` and no `(narrowing)` arm).
